players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Raleigh is on a power surge — 7 HRs this season with 5 in his last 7 games. Hit a two-run shot in the 8th of an 11-4 loss to Minnesota, keeping his hot power stretch going despite a .195 AVG.

sources.title: Mariners fall 11-4 to Twins as struggles continue

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper delivered 2 hits and 4 RBIs on Apr 26 as the Phillies ended their 10-game losing streak with an 8-5 extra-inning win over Atlanta. Phillies open a home series vs. San Francisco on April 28.

sources.title: Bryce Harper, Phillies Snap 10-Game Skid With Extra-Inning Win Over Braves

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez leads the Giants with a .305 AVG and an MLB-best hit rate, having struck out only 4 times in 115 plate appearances this season. Giants off today before opening a road series at Philadelphia on April 28.

sources.title: How Luis Arraez turns taking a pitch into performance art for SF Giants

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Scouts report Bichette is not fully healthy from a left knee PCL sprain sustained in September 2025, with his sprint speed down to 25.4 ft/sec. Mets are monitoring the situation; no IL placement currently.

sources.title: Mets Bo Bichette reportedly has a hidden injury problem from Blue Jays

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle is batting .322 with a .904 OPS as one of the AL's top rookies in 2026. He reached safely in 23 consecutive starts, the longest streak by a Tigers rookie since Austin Jackson in 2010.

sources.title: Detroit Tigers Kevin McGonigle stays grounded during strong start

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA swiped his 6th base of the year but the Cubs dropped their 3rd straight game, 9-7 to the surging Padres. He's posting just a .605 OPS in a rough recent stretch and is overdue for a breakout.

sources.title: Chicago Cubs at San Diego Padres Game Story 04/27/2026

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill drove in a run with a first-inning single as the Padres rolled to a 9-7 win. San Diego is scorching hot — 17 wins in 21 games — with Ty France (4 RBI, double and triple) leading Monday's charge.

sources.title: Padres outlast Cubs 9-7 behind Ty France 4-RBI night

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernandez delivered the go-ahead blow — a tiebreaking solo homer leading off the 8th (his 5th of 2026) — as the Dodgers beat the Pirates 8-4. He's batting .328 with 15 RBIs and is one of the Dodgers' most clutch performers early in 2026.

sources.title: Teoscar Hernandez hits tiebreaking homer in 8th inning and Dodgers beat Pirates 8-4

players.name: Giancarlo Stanton
players.summary: Stanton was placed on the 10-day IL on April 27 with a low-grade right calf strain. MRI confirmed the injury after he exited the April 25 game vs. Houston. Manager Boone: 'doesn't look too serious' and return when eligible is possible.

sources.title: Yankees slugger Giancarlo Stanton headed to injured list with low-grade right calf strain

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams threw a scoreless 9th with 2 Ks on April 26 in the Mets' game 2 doubleheader loss to Colorado — a positive sign after a brutal stretch. His season ERA stands at 7.56 over 10 appearances.

sources.title: NY Mets scored 1 run in 18 innings and got swept by Colorado

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler made his 2026 debut on April 25 after 253 days away, going 5 IP, 3 H, 2 ER, 6 K, 3 BB in the Phillies' 8-5 extra-inning win over Atlanta that snapped a 10-game losing streak. He showed his velocity (94.7 mph avg) is intact.

sources.title: Zack Wheeler returns strong as Phillies end losing streak

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans didn't start as Seth Lugo pitched for KC's walk-off win over Los Angeles on April 27. His ERA has climbed after a left thumb injury from a comebacker vs. Cleveland earlier in April.

sources.title: Thomas walk-off home run caps Royals 6-run rally for sweep of Angels

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns is one of 2026's breakout starters, holding a 2.42 ERA through 4 starts. His 98.5 mph fastball and low-90s slider with a 56.3% whiff rate have generated Cy Young buzz for the 2024 second-overall pick.

sources.title: Chase Burns Forcing a Conversation the Reds Front Office Cannot Ignore

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi has been one of 2026's bigger disappointments, allowing 9 HR over 6 starts with a 5.06 ERA. Questions are growing in Texas about his durability and whether he can return to 2025 form.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan was masterful on April 24 vs. Chicago (6.1 IP, 1 ER, career-tying 10 Ks) but the Dodgers' bullpen squandered the lead in a stunning loss. ERA sits at 4.78 through 5 starts — the number undersells how well he has pitched.

sources.title: Dodgers waste Emmet Sheehan gem in stunning loss to Cubs

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers started April 26 at Kansas City, allowing 3 ER in 5+ innings. The Angels lost the series finale 11-9 on a walk-off homer on April 27. His ERA is 4.60 through 8 starts in 2026 — he's been rewarding the Angels' faith in keeping him in the rotation.

sources.title: Reid Detmers Is Rewarding the Angels Faith in the Rotation

injuries.name: Giancarlo Stanton
injuries.note: Low-grade right calf strain confirmed by MRI on April 27. Exited April 25 game vs. HOU in 6th inning. Manager Boone said it doesn't look too serious but didn't want to wait. Return when eligible around May 5 is possible.

source.title: Yankees slugger Stanton headed to IL with low-grade right calf strain

injuries.name: Bo Bichette
injuries.note: Multiple scouts report Bichette has not fully recovered from a left knee PCL sprain sustained in September 2025. Sprint speed down to 25.4 ft/sec from pre-injury levels. Mets monitoring but no IL placement announced.

source.title: Mets Bo Bichette reportedly has a hidden injury problem from Blue Jays
